description: UNSAT — no durable move exists. 5 dims uniform weight 5, 3 strong competitors with response deltas that perfectly mirror my move deltas. For every move I might choose, at least one competitor has a response that ties or beats my lead, breaking the lead_margin=3 requirement. Solver must return UNSAT. Mirrors content-calendar-3 / channel-score-3 / swot-priorities-3 negative-test pattern.
_unsat_note: Each competitor can mirror ANY of my dim-additions. With lead_margin=3 (effectively requiring a clear lead since weights are 5), every potential move is matched dim-for-dim by at least one competitor response combo. The solver must surface this as UNSAT instead of returning a partial winner. Negative test mirrors content-calendar-3 pattern.
